Hi Lucas — thanks for the clear summary and the doc. Short answer: we can support per-entity invoicing and a split settlement model, but there are a few operational prerequisites on the CPPO side that tend to slow Seller Central issuance. Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):

1) Immediate (this week) — Legal & billing: BluePeak to share entity tax IDs + sample PO routing (contact: legal@bluepeak.com).
2) AWS step — Partner manager (Sophie) to kick off Seller Central private-offer creation and confirm required evidence (billing entity docs, reseller ID).
3) Redwood Ops — we will prepare an invoice-split template and a fallback single-entity invoice path if Seller Central cannot finalize the CPPO by 11/01.
4) Pilot — pick 1-2 customers for initial activation with a short canary period (30d).

Blockers we see on our side: SKU entitlement reconciliation (we'll need a mapping table), and automated provisioning to respect entitlements per reseller customer. I've attached our Redwood_CPPO_Guidance.pdf which outlines the common evidence and the technical SKU mapping format.

Can you confirm legal contact and whether BluePeak can agree to the 30-day pilot and the fallback invoicing? If so, we can loop in Kar thik to consolidate the DocuSign + HubSpot workflow.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Channel Partnerships

- CPPO creation is blocked until BluePeak provides billing entity verification for each legal entity (tax ID + registered address).
- Seller Central requires an authorized reseller ID and the signed order form (we can accept a scanned PO as interim).
- SKU splits are usually handled via entitlement mapping; please upload the mapping table in the private-offer evidence section.

Temporary fallback options while CPPO finalizes:
1) Public listing + reseller-managed credit note: reseller transacts via standard AWS Marketplace SKU and issues internal credits to reconcile pricing differences.
2) Temporary manual invoicing: Redwood invoices a single BluePeak entity and BluePeak handles internal cost allocation.

I'll open the Seller Central request now and will attach the checklist. Expect a response within 48 hours.
